snippet.title: Grow Harvest Repeat [Official Early Access Trailer]
snippet.description:
Buy Grow Harvest Repeat now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3488760/Grow_Harvest_Repeat

Grow Harvest Repeat is a  2D farming game where you build your farming empire. Take care of your garden, level up skills, and unlock new areas as you progress!

Earn by growing plants
Every farming empire starts in the garden — and so does yours. Buy seeds, grow crops, and sell yields - it helps you to get the first coins and will improve your skill. The better your farming skills, the more you can do.

Craft goods for sale
Why sell vegetables if you can make more profit selling vegetable salad? Build different devices for crafting. Sell ground coffee,  grilled corn, cheese, and much more. The better your crafting skills, the more profitable goods you can make.

Build barns and buy animals
When you become an experienced farmer, it's time to invest in livestock. Cows and chickens will bring you milk and eggs. When life gives you milk and eggs, make bread.  And sell it, of course!

Early Access
The game is in Early Access, with more features coming soon! Your feedback will help us shape and improve the game!

Thanks!
